title: Activity Timeline
content: Build activity timeline feed. Event types: posts created, likes, comments, follows, profile updates. Timeline structure: vertical list with connecting line. Event row: icon, description, timestamp. Filtering: filter by activity type. Date grouping: "Today", "Yesterday", "This Week". Expandable details for each event.

variants.simple: Create activity timeline showing user actions.
variants.detailed: Build activity timeline feed. Event types: posts created, likes, comments, follows, profile updates. Timeline structure: vertical list with connecting line. Event row: icon, description, timestamp. Filtering: filter by activity type. Date grouping: "Today", "Yesterday", "This Week". Expandable details for each event.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive activity timeline showing user actions history. Container: max-w-2xl mx-auto py-8. Timeline structure: relative, vertical line (absolute left-4 top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-gray-200) connecting events. Event grouping: group by date with sticky headers ("Today", "Yesterday", "January 15, 2024"). Event row: flex gap-4 relative pl-10 py-3. Icon circle: absolute left-0, w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center, colored based on event type (blue for posts, red for likes, green for follows, purple for comments). Icons: FileText for post, Heart for like, MessageCircle for comment, UserPlus for follow, Edit for profile update, Share2 for share. Event content: flex-1. Description: text with bold usernames and links, "[You] liked [Username]'s post" or "[You] started following [Username]". Timestamp: text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1. Preview: for posts/comments, show content preview (line-clamp-2 text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1). Link: entire row clickable to navigate to relevant content. Expandable details: ChevronDown to expand showing full content or context. Activity types: Post created, Post liked, Comment added, User followed, Profile updated (shows what changed), Photo added, Shared post, Mentioned in post, Tagged in photo. Filter bar: horizontal pills (All, Posts, Likes, Comments, Follows), active state styling. Undo actions: for recent actions, "Undo" link (e.g., undo follow within 5 minutes). Grouped activities: "You liked 5 posts" collapsed, expandable to see all. Analytics summary: top of timeline showing "This week: 12 posts, 47 likes, 8 comments" stats. Time range selector: This Week, This Month, All Time dropdown. Infinite scroll: load older events on scroll. Privacy control: setting to make activity public, followers-only, or private. Export: download activity data. Empty state: "No recent activity" with suggestions. Accessibility: timeline as list, events properly structured, dates announced.
